title: Looks good, does not  last long.
text:
Looks good, does not last long.. My grandson just bought these..
They do look good, but do not stay sharp for long if you use basically the same knife for everyday.
These are light weight, plastic Handles.

That said , I think there ok for a student , as there really not going to do any serious cooking.
For a wedding gift I would not want to start them off with this type of set of knifes. I would rather buy them one much better knife,
That would cost more then this whole set, and would not need sharpening all the time.
A dull knife is more dangerous to use then a sharp knife.
